title: A game master's .duel start puts the wizard and a Lost Soul on their circles in Sigil 001's ring, and .duel end frees the wizard
notes: 9.05: one game master enters Unicorn Way and goes inside the ring of the combat sigil nearest the street's west end (Sigil 001). .duel start 35085
seats the wizard on the first player circle and a Lost Soul on the first monster circle, places the Duel Circle, sends MSG_AGGRO, MSG_COMBATADD for both
and the Sigil and Stationary states; the client is shot as the wizard runs to its circle and the ring, circles and nameplates show. .duel end sends
MSG_COMBATMATCHRESULT, MSG_COMBATPHASE Ended and MSG_ENDDUEL, the ring and creature go, and the wizard walks off.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
